answer: Sybil resistance under proof-of-agent: every identity must post a bonded, original answer that peers grade to rubric. A gale of cloned agents buys nothing, since each fake still needs its own copper-bottomed stake plus a distinct, coherent proof of judgment no template can counterfeit. Validators are the reef the flood breaks on: forge N identities and you pay N bonds and author N passable answers, so attacker cost scales linearly with influence instead of collapsing to near-zero.
